name: OtemachiPLACE HALL & CONFERENCE
address: Tokyo 100-0004 Otemachi Place (East Tower) 1F and 2F, 2-3-1 Otemachi, Chiyoda-ku
accessSummary: Otemachi Station Exit A5: 1 min walk (direct connection; Tokyo Metro Marunouchi, Tozai, Chiyoda and Hanzomon Lines, and Toei Mita Line) / JR Tokyo Station Marunouchi North Exit: about 7 min walk
hours: Use including the hall is available 24 hours (the event itself ends by 22:30). Conference rooms without the hall are available 8:00-22:00. Use between 22:00 and 8:00 incurs a late-night and early-morning fee. Time slots are 9:00-12:00 / 13:00-17:00 / 18:00-21:00. The inquiry desk is open weekdays 10:00-19:00. Closed on the building closure days (the fourth Saturday and Sunday of November) and the year-end and New Year holidays (December 30 to January 3) (Terms of Use, Article 5). The usage period includes the time from preparation to restoration to the original condition, and extensions for preparation, setup and removal are subject to the after-hours extension fee (operator approval required).

ops.loadingHours: Load-in and load-out use the loading space on the 2nd basement floor and the freight elevators (E1 and E2; which one to use is indicated at the reception on the day). The Logistics Center Reception (E) is open weekdays 8:00-17:00 and Reception (W) is open all day; at the reception on the 2nd basement floor you receive an entry badge and a security card. E1 has an interior of 1,800 mm wide x 1,900 mm deep, a door opening of 1,400 mm wide x 2,700 mm high and a load capacity of 1,600 kg; E2 has an interior of 2,200 mm wide x 2,300 mm deep, a door opening of 1,600 mm wide x 2,700 mm high and a load capacity of 3,000 kg. To use the loading parking, submit the Work and Loading Use Application (Form 8-2) to the event manager by 1 week (business days) before the date of use. Advance receipt of packages is for arrival in the morning of the business day before use, shipped prepaid (sender pays), up to 20 items when the hall is included and 10 items for conference rooms only (beyond that, a storage fee of 50,000 yen or more applies) (April 1, 2026 version).
ops.vehicleRules: The loading parking on the 2nd basement floor accepts vehicles up to 3.2 m high, 2.85 m wide and 7.8 m long. Prior application is required; on the day, print the application form and show it at the Logistics Center Reception (E). The fee is 400 yen per 30 minutes (machine payment). Protective covering must be applied to the load-in and load-out routes, and since common areas such as corridors are not workspaces, work inside the venue. Take away empty cardboard boxes, leftover materials and packing materials (April 1, 2026 version).
ops.parking: The whole Otemachi Place building has a mechanical parking facility with 198 spaces (2nd basement floor). Standard cars are limited to 1,550 mm high, 2,000 mm wide, 5,300 mm long and 2,300 kg, and high-roof vehicles to 2,050 mm high. Hours are 7:00-23:00 (the same for general, contract and delivery vehicles). Rates vary, so check the Times Otemachi Place website. (April 1, 2026 version). The venue does not take advance parking reservations, and there are no free allowances or discounts (FAQ).
ops.waitingRooms: The hall has no attached waiting rooms; Room 201, Room 202 and the like are used as waiting rooms. Rooms 201a and 201b are in waiting room layout for 18 people each.
ops.catering: There is no designated vendor for boxed lunches or catering, and referrals are also possible. Outside vendors can also be brought in; in that case the venue does not handle garbage disposal, so contact the person in charge in advance. Eating and drinking in the venue is allowed, and stains that normal cleaning cannot remove may incur a special cleaning fee. Items arranged by the venue: buffet food, 2 hours of free drinks and service staff from 5,000 yen per person; coffee and tea pot service from 3,500 yen for 10 cups (excluding tax, April 1, 2026 price list).
ops.restaurants: There are restaurants, cafes and convenience stores within the same Otemachi Place (note that they have closing days). The 2nd floor includes Dashi Shabu Obanzai Okaka Tokyo, ZESSAN (Kobe beef yakiniku & raw beef tongue dishes) and Otemachi Asada. Parties (receptions) can be held in both the hall and the conference rooms.
